classificationUpdates.inventorySource: PUN inventory snapshot from canonical Italy reconstruction; 80 EVSE / 17 stations
classificationUpdates.tariffChannel: direct CPO / ad-hoc at A22-operated chargers; roaming eMSP prices kept separate

tariffs.connectorApplicability: Type 2 dedicated AC charger, up to 22 kW per vehicle / 11 kW when two vehicles share the charger
CCS Combo 2 50 kW, CHAdeMO 50 kW, or Type 2 up to 43 kW on the A22 multi-standard charger topology
CCS Combo 2 up to 180 kW on public passenger sites; A22 also publishes the same EUR 0.43/kWh for its 600 kW CCS / 1000 kW MCS heavy-vehicle-only equipment

conditions: Apply by exact charger topology/connector class, not by a generic arbitrary power threshold when the EVSE topology is unknown.
Bolzano Sud/Firmian 600 kW CCS and CCS+MCS installation is explicitly restricted to heavy vehicles authorized by A22 and must not be ranked as an ordinary passenger-car charging option.
Third-party operators physically near A22 sites (Tesla, Electra, Enel X, Ewiva, etc.) retain their own partyIds and tariffs and are not covered by this A22 rule.
paymentMethods: direct/ad-hoc charging supported at A22 chargers; payment implementation documented in A22 usage instructions / current station metadata
roaming/eMSP, where available, remains a separate tariff channel

coveredSubpopulations.scope: PUN partyId A22 public passenger-car inventory
coveredSubpopulations.reason: Current official A22 service-area page enumerates the public passenger charging sites and assigns explicit EUR/kWh prices to each A22 charger topology; the canonical PUN A22 inventory contains 17 public stations.

uncoveredSubpopulations.scope: 600 kW CCS and CCS+MCS heavy-vehicle-only chargers
uncoveredSubpopulations.reason: Official A22 page explicitly restricts these chargers to heavy vehicles authorized by A22; excluded from ordinary passenger-car ranking even though the published energy price is 0.43 EUR/kWh.

coverage.failClosedRule: If an imported A22 EVSE cannot be mapped to one of the three published A22 charger topologies, do not rank it until topology is resolved.

positiveEvidence: Current official A22 page publishes 0.33 EUR/kWh for dedicated AC chargers (Type 2 up to 22 kW / 11 kW shared).
Current official A22 page publishes 0.38 EUR/kWh for multi-standard chargers (CCS 50 kW, CHAdeMO 50 kW, Type 2 up to 43 kW).
Current official A22 page publishes 0.43 EUR/kWh for ultra-rapid CCS up to 180 kW and separately for the restricted Bolzano Sud/Firmian 600 kW CCS / 1000 kW MCS heavy-vehicle installation.

The official page enumerates 17 passenger-accessible A22 charging sites; this matches the canonical PUN A22 station count of 17. A separate Bolzano Sud/Firmian heavy-vehicle-only installation is explicitly eligibility-restricted.
Current PUMP discovery metadata for A22 Po Ovest corroborates the exact mixed topology: dedicated Type 2 22 kW plus multi-standard Type 2 43 kW / CCS 50 kW / CHAdeMO 50 kW.
negativeEvidence: Do not infer A22 pricing for co-located Tesla/Electra/Enel X/Ewiva hardware; those use different partyIds.
Do not make the Bolzano Sud/Firmian heavy-vehicle-only installation a passenger-car result merely because a tariff is public.
classificationUpdates.resumeCondition: Re-open only if A22 changes its official tariff table/topologies, the PUN A22 station inventory no longer matches the public A22 site scope, or a new A22 EVSE topology appears outside the published classes.
